features.name: Fey Presence

effects.note: Your patron grants you the magic of the fey, and your spells and patron's spells can summon fey creatures from the Feywild. You know the druidcraft cantrip, castable at will without a slot, and you know one first-level druid spell. At 6th and 14th level you learn another cantrip or spell of that level.

features.summary: Druidcraft at will, plus a free 1st-level druid spell
features.text: You know the druidcraft cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot, and you know one first-level druid spell.

features.name: Misty Escape

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to vanish, mistily teleporting up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. At 6th and 16th level, a creature that tries to attack you instead has advantage on the attack roll but must then target a different creature.

features.summary: Bonus action: teleport 30 ft as a bonus action
features.text: You can use a bonus action to vanish, mistily teleporting up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.
features.note: At 6th and 16th level, a creature that tries to attack you instead has advantage on the attack roll but must then target a different creature.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses

trigger.note: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell cast by a creature you can see within 30 feet.

effects.note: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell cast by a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw, and on a failure it is charmed by you until the end of your next turn. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: charm a caster whose spell you resisted
features.text: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell cast by a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw.

features.name: Dark Delirium

effects.note: You have mingled the gnoll's screams with the fey family'slaughter, which can ward off those who harm you. When you are damaged, you can use your reaction to give a creature within 60 feet that you can see disadvantage on attack rolls against you for 1 minute, or you can be affected by your own feature and frightened for 1 minute instead. At 18th level, if the damage is psychic, you and the creature must each make a Wisdom save or be frightened. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.
If the damage is psychic, you and the creature must each make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the next turn.

features.summary: Reaction when damaged: attackers get disadvantage, or you take it
features.text: When you are damaged, you can use your reaction to give a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see disadvantage on attack rolls against you for 1 minute.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing

effects.note: When you make a spell attack, you can add 1d6 to the damage. Choose one of three fiend benefits at 1st level, another at 6th, and another at 10th, and replace it at 10th level.

features.summary: +1d6 to spell attacks, plus your fiend benefit
features.text: When you make a spell attack, you can add 1d6 to the damage.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck

effects.note: The fiend's own luck manifests in your darkest moments. When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to reroll the die, and you must use the new roll. You regain the use of this when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: reroll a failed save
features.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to reroll the die. You must use the new roll.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience

effects.note: You gain resistance to damage from any fiend or demon you're able to see, and when you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to succeed instead. You can use this twice, but only once before 16th level. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: succeed on a failed save; resist fiend damage
features.text: You gain resistance to damage from any fiend or demon you're able to see. When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to succeed instead.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell

effects.note: When you touch a creature, you can hurl it up to 30 feet, and it must make a Constitution saving throw or take 3d10 fire damage and be thrown up to 30 feet. If it strikes a creature, the target creature makes a Constitution saving throw or takes the same 3d10 fire damage, and if it strikes a solid object, it is stunned until the end of your next turn. At 18th level you can use this twice per long rest.

features.summary: Action: hurl a creature 30 ft, dealing 3d10 on impact
features.text: When you touch a creature, you can hurl it up to 30 feet. It must make a Constitution saving throw or take 3d10 fire damage and be thrown up to 30 feet.

features.name: Awakened Mind

effects.note: Your patron has augmented your magic with its own power, adding two spells from the warlock list to your repertoire. At 6th and 14th level you learn another warlock spell of 1st level or higher, always prepared.

features.summary: Two extra warlock spells, plus more at 6th and 14th
features.text: Your patron has augmented your magic with its own power, adding two spells from the warlock list to your repertoire.

features.name: Entropic Ward

effects.note: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain 1d6 plus your Charisma modifier in temporary hit points. You gain the use when you finish a short or long rest, and at 16th level you gain two uses.

features.summary: Reaction: 1d6 + Cha temp HP when you fail a save
features.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain 1d6 + your Charisma modifier in temporary hit points.

features.name: Thought Shield

effects.note: You have resistance to psychic damage, and at 6th level and higher, when you are affected by a spell, you can use your reaction to cause the spell to fail against you and instead transfer its effect to a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The spell's user rolls against a DC of 10 + your Charisma modifier plus your proficiency bonus, and it ends at the start of the next turn if it has not ended already.

features.summary: Psychic resistance; redirect a spell that affects you
features.text: You have resistance to psychic damage, and when you are affected by a spell, you can use your reaction to cause the spell to fail against you.

features.name: Create Thrall

effects.note: You can cast the create undead spell without a material component. When you do so, choose the creature type: create a thrall from the Find Familiar spell, or take control of a humanoid or beast within 10 feet that has fewer than your Hit Dice total by shifting all its Hit Dice over to yourself.

features.summary: Action, once a day: cast create undead without components
features.text: You can cast the create undead spell without a material component.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to curse a creature within 30 feet, which becomes charmed by you for 1 hour or until you drop to 0 hit points or die. You have advantage on attack rolls against the cursed creature, and it has disadvantage on saving throws against spells you cast, and you get a +1 bonus to all damage rolls against it. You can curse one creature at a time, and at 16th level you can use it twice per long rest.

features.summary: Bonus action: charm a creature, then hit it harder
features.text: You can use a bonus action to curse a creature within 30 feet of you. It is charmed by you for 1 hour, and you have advantage on attack rolls against it.

features.name: Hex Warrior

effects.note: You have proficiency with medium armor, and your Constitution score is increased by 1. At 3rd level and every odd level after that, you gain another increase of 1 and you gain proficiency with another type of armor or shield.

features.summary: +1 Con per level, medium armor, more armor at odd levels
features.text: You gain proficiency with medium armor and your Constitution score is increased by 1. At 3rd level and every odd level after that, you gain another increase of 1.

features.name: Accursed Specter

effects.note: You conjure a phantom warrior within your reach, made of translucent force, and it lasts for 1 minute or until it takes 30 damage. It doesn't require a slot, and it occupies your space and can attack anyone but you within 5 feet of it, dealing 1d6 necrotic damage on a hit.

features.summary: A free spectral warrior that attacks anyone but you
features.text: You conjure a phantom warrior within your reach. It lasts for 1 minute or until it takes 30 damage, and it can attack anyone but you within 5 feet of it.

features.name: Armor of Hexes

effects.note: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor. If you hit a creature with an attack roll, you have disadvantage on all attack rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn, and at 14th level you also impose disadvantage on its ability checks.
You also impose disadvantage on the target's ability checks until the end of your next turn.

features.summary: +1 AC in armor; attacks hinder the creature you hit
features.text: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor. If you hit a creature with an attack roll, you have disadvantage on all attack rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Master of Hexes

effects.note: You have fallen far enough into the curse that you can curse more creatures. At 16th level, if you hit a creature with a Hexblade's Curse and it is within 60 feet of you, you can use your reaction to apply the curse to any number of creatures of your choice within 60 feet of the first, each of which must make a Wisdom save and is affected by your previous Hexblade's Curse, and at 18th level you can use your reaction to remove it from one of those creatures.

features.summary: Spread the Hexblade's Curse to nearby creatures
features.text: You can use your reaction to apply Hexblade's Curse to any number of creatures of your choice within 60 feet of the cursed creature.

features.name: Bonus Cantrips

effects.note: Your patron's influence has brought you the power of clerics: you learn the sacred flame cantrip, castable at will without a slot, and you know three more cantrips from the cleric list. At 6th and 16th level, you gain two additional cantrips from the cleric list.

features.summary: Sacred flame at will, plus three more cleric cantrips
features.text: Your patron's influence has brought you the power of clerics. You learn the sacred flame cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Healing Light

effects.note: Your patron's mercy has a tangible manifestation. As a bonus action, you can restore 1d8 hit points to a creature that you can see within 60 feet, and it ends charmed or frightened. You gain additional uses at 2nd, 6th, 10th and 14th level, regaining all on a long rest.

features.summary: Bonus action: heal 1d8 and end charmed or frightened
features.text: As a bonus action, you can restore 1d8 hit points to a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you, and it ends charmed or frightened.

features.name: Radiant Soul

effects.note: You have resistance to radiant damage, and you can add 1d6 radiant damage to one attack or spell you make, and at 17th level you can use this twice per long rest, adding a second d6 each time.

features.summary: Radiant resistance; add 1d6 radiant to an attack or spell
features.text: You have resistance to radiant damage, and you can add 1d6 radiant damage to one attack or spell you make.

features.name: Celestial Resilience

effects.note: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to heal 1d8 plus your Charisma modifier in hit points instead, and if you do, the damage you take is halved if it would come from that spell. You regain the use when you finish a short or long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: 1d8 + Cha healing instead of a failed save
features.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to heal 1d8 + your Charisma modifier in hit points instead.

features.name: Searing Vengeance

effects.note: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to add 3d8 radiant damage to the attack, to be shared between you and the attacker, and it ends only at the end of your next turn. You can also use this when a creature within 60 feet that you can see is hit by an attack. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: split 3d8 radiant with the creature that hit you
features.text: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to add 3d8 radiant damage to the attack, to be shared between you and the attacker.

features.name: Bonus Spells

effects.note: Your patron's influence has brought you the magic of druids: you know the druidcraft cantrip, castable at will, and you know one first-level druid spell castable without a slot. At 6th and 14th level you learn another cantrip or spell of that level.

features.summary: Druidcraft at will, plus a free 1st-level druid spell
features.text: Your patron's influence has brought you the magic of druids. You know the druidcraft cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deep

effects.note: You can magically summon a grasping tentacle from a creature within 10 feet of you, and it grapples the creature if it is Medium or smaller and you succeed on a Strength check. While the creature is grappled, the tentacle can hold or crush it, and at 10th level you can use this twice per long rest.

features.summary: Bonus action: a grasping tentacle that grapples
features.text: You can magically summon a grasping tentacle from a creature within 10 feet of you.

features.name: Gift of the Sea

effects.note: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain 1d8 plus your Charisma modifier in temporary hit points, and the taking of damage has a chance of rewarding your patron's gift with magical currents that temporarily enhance your ability. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: 1d8 + Cha temp HP when damaged
features.text: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain 1d8 + your Charisma modifier in temporary hit points.

features.name: Oceanic Soul

effects.note: You gain resistance to lightning damage and your speed is increased by 10 feet while underwater, and you can swim up to your walking speed. At 7th level your swimming speed is equal to your walking speed instead of half of it.

features.summary: Lightning resistance; swim at your walking speed underwater
features.text: You gain resistance to lightning damage, and your speed is increased by 10 feet while underwater, and you can swim up to your walking speed.

features.name: Guardian Coil

effects.note: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain the following benefits until the start of your next turn: your movement is not hindered by difficult terrain, you don't have disadvantage on saving throws or ability checks due to being underwater, and you have resistance to force damage. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: no underwater penalties after a failed save
features.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain the following benefits until the start of your next turn: your movement is not hindered by difficult terrain.

features.name: Grasping Tentacles

effects.note: Tentacles lash out, and you can add an ability modifier to the tentacles' damage: +2d6 bludgeoning on a hit or +2d6 cold on a miss, and at 18th level a creature you hit with a tentacle has disadvantage on all saving throws until the end of your next turn.

features.summary: Tentacles deal 2d6 on hit or miss; +8 with your modifier
features.text: You can add an ability modifier to the tentacles' damage. If you do, damage on a hit increases by 2d6 bludgeoning damage or on a miss by 2d6 cold damage.

features.name: Bonus Spells

effects.note: Your patron's influence has brought you the magic of wizards: you know the mage hand cantrip, castable at will without a slot, and you know one first-level wizard spell castable without a slot. At 6th and 14th level you learn another cantrip or spell of that level.

features.summary: Mage hand at will, plus a free 1st-level wizard spell
features.text: Your patron's influence has brought you the magic of wizards. You know the mage hand cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Genie's Vessel

effects.note: You know the genie's trick of the wish vessel, and you can draw on the vessel's magic for a brief moment. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain 1d6 plus your Charisma modifier in temporary hit points. You gain the use when you finish a short or long rest, and at 10th and 16th level you gain additional uses.

features.summary: Reaction: 1d6 + Cha temp HP when damaged
features.text: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain 1d6 + your Charisma modifier in temporary hit points.

features.name: Elemental Gift

effects.note: You know the genie's elemental power, and you can use an action to gain a +2 bonus to AC, +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls, resistance to nonmagical ranged attacks, and a limited number of extra attacks, all for 1 minute, and it ends if you don for it within 10 minutes.

features.summary: Darkvision; an action for +2 AC and attacks for a minute
features.text: You know the genie's elemental power and you gain a number of additional Limited uses of the elemental gift.

features.name: Sanctuary Vessel

effects.note: The vessel is a vessel indeed, and while you are in it you have advantage on Charisma checks and saves. When you finish a short or long rest, you can regain hit points equal to 1d6 plus twice your Charisma modifier, and you can cast one wizard cantrip without a spell slot.

features.summary: Advantage on Cha checks; heal 1d6 + 2x Cha on a rest
features.text: The vessel is a vessel indeed, and you gain advantage on Charisma checks and saves. When you finish a short or long rest, you can regain hit points equal to 1d6 + twice your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Limited Wish

effects.note: You have learned to make a smaller, more controlled version of the genie's magic. You can cast the wish spell without a spell slot and without material components, choosing an effect you are certain of, other than contact with a creature or object, which can be of a level equal to your warlock level or lower. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Action: cast wish without a slot, bounded to your level
features.text: You can cast the wish spell without a spell slot and without material components.

features.name: Form of Dread

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to assume a terrifying spectral form, which lasts until you dismiss it as a bonus action, or until you die. While in the form, you gain resistance to nonmagical attacks, immunity to being frightened, and creatures within 5 feet of you that can see you have disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed and frightened.

features.summary: Bonus action: a terrifying form, immune to fear, nonmagical resistant
features.text: You can use a bonus action to assume a terrifying spectral form, which lasts until you dismiss it as a bonus action, or until you die.

features.name: Grave Touched

effects.note: Your magic comes from the shameless dead, and you can wound the living. When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to force a Constitution saving throw, and on a failure it takes 1d8 plus your Charisma modifier necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the end of your next turn. At 16th level you gain a second use, and at 18th level you gain a third.

features.summary: Reaction: 1d8 + Cha necrotic and no healing, when hit
features.text: When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Constitution saving throw.

features.name: Necrotic Husk

effects.note: The necrotic energy of your patron's power has taken a physical toll on you, and your flesh has become more like that of a revenant. At 10th level, you can keep dead creatures that die within 10 feet of you, putting them in your space as a small object that disappears when you do. You can use a bonus action to gain a +1 bonus to AC and damage rolls for 1 minute, and you regain hit points equal to half your missing hit points.

features.summary: You can rise from the dead and turn corpses into objects
features.text: At 10th level, you can keep dead creatures that die within 10 feet of you, putting them in your space.

features.name: Spirit Projection

effects.note: You know a ritual that can temporarily give your spells incredible reach, and you project your spirit through your surroundings. As a bonus action, you project your spirit from your body up to 60 feet away, gaining resistance to all damage, and it vanishes if you cast a spell or use a Magic action. Your spirit can't leave the area and ends if it is in sunlight.

features.summary: Bonus action: project your spirit 60 ft, resistant to all damage
features.text: As a bonus action, you project your spirit from your body up to 60 feet away from you, gaining resistance to all damage.

features.name: Among the Dead

effects.note: The undying can feel the cold pull of death's door, and you learn to push back. You learn the necrotic cantrip, castable at will without a slot. When a creature within 10 feet of you that is hostile to you drops to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to take 1d6 plus your Constitution modifier in temporary hit points.

features.summary: Necrotic at will; temp HP when an enemy drops nearby
features.text: You learn the necrotic cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot. When a creature within 10 feet of you that is hostile to you drops to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to take 1d6 + your Constitution modifier in temporary hit points.

features.name: Undying Nature

effects.note: You have learned a few basic survivability tricks, such as the conjurer's avoidance of poisoned death and artificer's winding yourself in protective magic. When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain 1d8 plus your Constitution modifier in temporary hit points, and the DM must reroll the save, and you gain the use of this when you finish a short or long rest.
The temporary hit points increase to 2d8 plus your Constitution modifier, and you gain the use when you finish a short or long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: 1d8 + Con temp HP and a reroll after a failed save
features.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain 1d8 + your Constitution modifier in temporary hit points, and the DM must reroll the save.

features.name: Beyond the Grave

effects.note: You have learnt the curse of the broken body can be a source of power. When you are damaged, you can make a Charisma saving throw with a DC of 5 plus your Constitution modifier, and on a success you reduce the damage by half. At 18th level the DC is 10 plus your Constitution modifier instead.
The Charisma saving throw DC is 10 plus your Constitution modifier instead of 5 plus.

features.summary: A Cha save halves damage you take
features.text: When you are damaged, you can make a Charisma saving throw with a DC of 5 + your Constitution modifier. On a success, you reduce the damage by half.

features.name: Indestructible Life

effects.note: You have learned a few basic survivability tricks that require magic. When you make a Death saving throw, you can choose to take 1d4 plus your Constitution modifier in temporary hit points, and if you do, you automatically succeed on the save. When you would be reduced to 0 hit points by damage that isn't psychic, you can instead drop to 1 hit point.

features.summary: Death saves get 1d4 + Con temp HP; drop to 1 on non-psychic damage
features.text: When you make a Death saving throw, you can choose to take 1d4 + your Constitution modifier in temporary hit points, and if you do, you automatically succeed on the save.
